messages:
maria: OK team, low-priority but HIGH CULTURE. proposing a new office tradition: the 'Neon Penguin Pledge'. short, silly, and snack-adjacent. thoughts?
jon: obsessed. what's the pledge text?
devon: if it involves snacks i'm in. also protect the ficus.
maria: draft: 1) Always bring snacks when you can. 2) Fix the coffee machine if you break it (or buy donuts). 3) Meme responsibly and credit the source. 4) Neon penguin stewardship rotates weekly.
katie: do we get stickers? :eyes:
rewards-bot: :penguin: Awarded "Neon Penguin Sticker" to @katie for suggestion
sean: i call dibs on being inaugural steward. will accept the role and any tiny statues.
linda: does someone actually own a penguin statue? asking for desk placement logistics.
jon: i think we have a sad plastic flamingo in the storage closet. spray paint + googly eyes = penguin?
devon: i have neon spray paint. volunteering for artisan duties.
katie: can we make a 2-min Friday ritual — penguin oath + snack unveiling?
maria: yes. short & sweet. propose a signed pledge sheet on the snack shelf.
sean: secret handshake ideas: elbow bump + two claps + jazz hands?
linda: jazz hands are a hard pass.
jon: elbow bump + air penguin waddle.
katie: poll (react to this msg): :thumbsup: 3pm on Fridays, :smile: 4pm, :tada: noon. react pls.
sean: will practice handshake and post a terrible demo video in this thread. you have been warned. :grimacing:
maria: tiny governance note — stewardship includes keeping the penguin clean, not stealing other people's lunches, and one small discretionary snack purchase each week.
devon: adding "respect the FRIDGE LABELS" to the pledge.
linda: agreed. fridge law is sacred.
jon: motion to adopt Neon Penguin Pledge by consensus.
katie: seconded.
rewards-bot: :sparkles: "Neon Penguin Pledge" added to Office Lore (channel: #random)
maria: motion passes. ceremonial neon penguin to be painted this weekend. volunteers: @devon (paint), @jon (procure googly eyes), @katie (sticker design), @sean (steward week 1).
sean: honored. will not let the penguin down. promise. :penguin:
maria: perfect. new tradition incoming. may it bless our snack runs and banish stale coffee. :sparkles:
